alignments.note: Appositional even before the repeated pronoun; no marker or connective morpheme stands to license it, and the second אַתָּה already holds its own thou and is not a home for a second word (rules 16, 30, 51). Competing reading: even joined to the second pronoun as the ASV's rendering of the emphatic repetition.
Repeated pronoun takes only its own thou.
Niphal participle predicate with construction-supplied copula and passive infinitive frame (rule 20); discontinuous around the repeated pronoun (rule 25).
Modal and lexical verb to the finite verb (rule 17).
ASV spends a word on each morpheme of לְפָנֶיךָ (in / thy / sight), so rule 2 splits rather than fusing under rule 30.
מֵאָז rendered by the fixed pair when once; fused under rule 30 with source head on the content-bearing adverb. Target head on when; competing head once.
Noun anger recast as the predicate art angry; copula joins the predicate (rule 20).
Suffix realized as the subject pronoun of the recast clause (rules 18, 40).

review_notes: Corrected: the even of Thou, even thou is an appositional even no morpheme licenses; marked added under rule 16 rather than folded into the repeated pronoun, which already holds its own thou.
